title: Broadcast uses --skip-simulation with an offline-derived stale-able minBPT; no live re-query enforced
reconciliationNote: STILL-OPEN (mitigated, not closed) at HEAD 30775401 (run phoenix-phase-2-staging-10, mainnet fork @ block 25242176). MITIGATION: pool() is now wrapped in a try/catch (step 17), so a too-high stale floor that reverts pool() no longer rolls back or strands the already-committed dispatcher cutover — it logs 'LP add DEFERRED', parks the seeded sUSDS recoverably for a later manual re-pool (fork-proven: forced MIN_BPT_WEI=1e23 reverts pool() but the cutover stays committed and step-16 mint(4) still succeeds). RESIDUAL (keeps L-01 open): no live in-script minBPT re-query was added; the floor is still the offline DEFAULT_MIN_BPT=284e18 / MIN_BPT_WEI env constant, and broadcast still carries --skip-simulation. A stale-too-low floor still weakens slippage protection on the single LP add; a stale-too-high floor silently defers the LP add. The run-09 worst case (stranded half-cutover) is resolved; the weak-slippage / silent-LP-deferral residual persists.
